text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Chan-Tap?!
That DJ is on a whole 'nother level, right~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Foo~~~!
This thrilling music makes it feel like a feast!
I'm glad I took you up on your invitation!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Talk about vibes going through the roof!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tap-chan, your party energy is seriously insane!
You're so hype it's not even funny, it's straight-up hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "The excitement's through the roof! It'd be a waste not to make some noise!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy this banquet to the absolute fullest today!
Helios!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It seems they enjoyed the club together with Daitaku Helios and spent a very fulfilling day off!
